title: Map each source rule
prompt: Choose the permission shape for each source rule.

pairs.item: Readable by clinical staff or pharmacists.
pairs.why: Either group is enough: list both groups.

pairs.item: Readable only by users in both the pharmacist group and clinic 014.
pairs.why: A user must belong to every group within one intersection entry.

pairs.item: Nurse leads are a member group of clinical staff.
pairs.why: Index the membership with memberGroupName rather than flattening users.

pairs.item: Source admins can read every page through a bypass.
pairs.why: Do not mirror the bypass unless the customer decides otherwise; grant access through groups.

takeaway: Map the rule, not the result you hope for.
